SELECT add_provenance('part');
SELECT set_prob(provenance(), prob) FROM part;
CREATE TABLE partsupp (c1 bigint, c2 bigint, prob float8);

SELECT add_provenance('partsupp');
SELECT set_prob(provenance(), prob) FROM partsupp;
CREATE TABLE q16_size (c1 bigint);
COPY q16_size FROM STDIN;

\.
CREATE VIEW q16 AS SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS c1 FROM partsupp t0, part t1, q16_size t2 WHERE t1.c1 = t0.c1 AND t1.c5 = 'medium' AND t1.c6 = 'polished' AND t2.c1 = t1.c8 AND t1.c4 <> 'brand45';
